params.name: page
params.description: Page number for paginated results. Defaults to the first page if omitted.

params.name: dateStart
params.description: Filter invoices created on or after this date or date-time. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. If time is omitted, `00:00:00` is assumed. If `dateEnd` is provided, it must not be earlier than `dateStart`.

params.name: dateEnd
params.description: Filter invoices created on or before this date or date-time. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. If time is omitted, `23:59:59` is assumed. If `dateStart` is provided, `dateEnd` must not be earlier than `dateStart`.

params.name: invoiceNumber
params.description: Filter invoices by the exact invoice number. Matches exactly (case-insensitive). If no match exists, no invoices are returned.

params.name: customerId
params.description: Filter invoices by customer ID.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter invoices by status.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter invoices by type.

params.name: currency
params.description: Filter invoices by currency code.

params.name: withConvenienceFee
params.description: Include the convenience fee for each invoice.  If `1`, the convenience fee is included in the response.  If `0` or omitted, the convenience fee is set to 0.

params.name: withOrderFields
params.description: Include custom field values for each invoice. If `1`, the `orderFields` array for each invoice is populated. If `0` or omitted, `orderFields` is always an empty array.

params.name: convenienceFeeEnabled
params.description: Filter invoices by whether the convenience fee is enabled.  If `1`, return all invoices with the convenience fee enabled. If `0`, return all invoices with the convenience fee disabled.  If omitted, no filter is applied.

params.name: invoiceId
params.description: The unique ID of the invoice to retrieve.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for paginated results.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of transactions that will be returned in one request. We only allow maximum 125 objects per request.  If no limit specified, the default limit will be 125 objects.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Filter transactions created on or after this date. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`. If `endDate` is provided, it must not be earlier than `startDate`.

params.name: endDate
params.description: Filter transactions created on or before this date. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`. If `startDate` is provided, `endDate` must not be earlier than `startDate`.

params.name: amountMin
params.description: Filter transactions by minimum amount. If `amountMax` is provided, `amountMin` must not be greater than `amountMax`.

params.name: amountMax
params.description: Filter transactions by maximum amount. If `amountMin` is provided, `amountMax` must not be less than `amountMin`.

params.name: statusAuth
params.description: Filter transactions by auth status.

params.name: statusClearing
params.description: Filter transactions by clearing status.

params.name: users
params.description: Filter transactions by users.
